mentions.name: agent-auth
mentions.description: A tool that gives AI coding agents like Codex SSH authentication without storing private keys on the server. It presents a normal SSH_AUTH_SOCK to the agent, supports sudo through pam_ssh_agent_auth, and routes signing requests to the 1Password SSH agent on an available Mac or to Agent Witness on a phone.
mentions.problem: Giving an AI agent the access it needs without leaving private keys and other credentials on the server.
mentions.source_excerpt: For SSH (and sudo through pam_ssh_agent_auth), I ended up building agent-auth and Agent Witness. Codex sees a normal SSH_AUTH_SOCK and supplies some context about why it needs a signature. If one of my Macs is available, agent-auth proxies the request to the 1Password SSH agent there. Otherwise it routes the request to Agent Witness on my phone.
mentions.author: evanpurkhiser
